subsequent_measurement_changes: The first development run passed 28/28 and is retained as that earlier script version, not substituted for the frozen final run.
Before final freeze, N3 began capturing source bytes before A completion and comparing them after completion; the first development script had captured that reference after completion.

Before final freeze, the private-source check additionally required that B evaluator read_set omit the private upstream object; the initial development report checked actual session read denials only.
The declared N2=17 and N3=11 checks were preserved; these tightened fields were rechecked by the actual group harness tests and the final frozen run.

interpretation.N2_branches: One common published-prefix checkpoint is copied for relabel_only and actual_update. Adoption alone changes no file bytes. Both then bind source_ref and derived_from to v2; the stale number6 fails, while actual number8 passes.
interpretation.N2_publication: World source JSON v1=6 is shared with A/B. A subscribes and follows current_published; B has fixed v1 and does not subscribe. Draft v2=8 changes no release/share/message/target. A/B are in explicit release scope, but only A receives subscription-derived v2 access and review notice; B retains v1.
interpretation.N3_branch_count: Six condition copies cover five strategy families because old_fixed and old_current are separate policy controls. N3 has 11 declared aggregate checks, often containing six-condition matrices; it must not be described as only 11 scalar observations or inflated to an unreported denominator.
interpretation.N3_scalar: Published historical intermediate v1 has6 and is not asserted to pass the current final8 producer contract. Final correct v2 has8. Wrong approved v3 uses SUM(A1,A2) and has16.
interpretation.N3_institutional_boundary: Every A branch uses real Bob approve and then manager close_project. All retain accepted institutional A decisions. Every B submission uses delivery_only and is institutionally accepted even when its independent content check fails. A is closed before B consumes and submits.
interpretation.N3_quality_boundary: wrong_approved independently rejects A against fixed expected8, while B faithfully copies its exact published16 interface and passes the narrower consistency contract. This is not a claim of correct downstream financial content or end-to-end quality.
interpretation.N3_privacy_boundary: For every branch, Bob in B and Bob in A both make actual read_object attempts against Alice-only private input and are denied. B evaluator read_set does not include that private object. Passing source checks read only B submitted JSON and the precisely adopted public workbook. The old_current case rejects at the submission policy target check before reading any source workbook; it must not be reported as all B evaluations reading one source workbook.
interpretation.N3_layout_boundary: Single combined JSON and two nonconflicting JSON files combine to the same fields, use the same exact source and both pass. Each file contributing value or source_ref binds that source in derived_from.
interpretation.unchanged_history: Evaluation is read-only for state, formal review records and immutable/mirror byte maps; changing current adoptions or publication does not rewrite already captured submission meaning.
interpretation.no_expansion: No additional project, industry, real financial process trace, model/API/GPU/training, concurrent-writer or recovery claim is derived from this group.
